name: Going To War
overview: Scripture acknowledges that there is a divinely appointed time for war as well as peace, recognizing the reality of conflict in a fallen world (Ecclesiastes 3:8). Believers are called to pursue peace with others whenever possible (Romans 12:18), while also understanding that governing authorities bear the sword as ministers of God's justice to punish evil (Romans 13:4). Though wars and rumors of wars will occur, Christians are reminded not to be troubled, for these events are part of God's sovereign plan and do not signify the immediate end (Matthew 24:6). Ultimately, doing justice brings joy to the righteous, whereas wickedness leads to destruction (Proverbs 21:15).
